Commentary.Commentary: There's still about 12 overs left in the day and Pakistan will look to scalp at least a couple of wickets before the end of the day. Pakistan had a good day with the bat. They had a firm lead to begin with and they capitalized on that with everyone chipping in. Babar fell agonizingly short of what would have been a well-deserved ton, while Sarfraz scored consecutive fifties. The hosts are in a dominant position though, and it all boils down to how the Aussies see this last phase of Day 3 out. Don't go anywhere, the final innings will begin shortly.

And there comes the call from the dressing room. PAKISTAN HAVE DECLARED AND SET A TARGET OF 538 for Australia. Everyone was expecting it to come much sooner, though it seems like the skipper was waiting to get to a hundred. Since he couldn't, the call was made almost instantly.
Similar delivery, worked down on the leg side by Abbas.
Turning into the batsman, on middle stump, turned away on the leg side.
Hangs on the back foot again and keeps it out.
Sweeps this away on the leg side but no run taken.
Waits for the ball to come in to him and then blocks.
Flighted and coming in on off, Abbas defends it from deep inside the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Close! Almost bowled. Labuschagne bowls the leg break on middle, it spins in and catches the pads of the batsman. Hamza fails to connect, the ball goes off the pads and past the off stick. Wasn't far away at all.
The googly around off, beats the edge of the bat and goes into the keeper's gloves.
Turning in from around off, Hamza defends from within the crease.
Mir Hamza is the last batsman in for Pakistan.

OUT! Even the skipper misses out on a ton. A good knock though nonetheless. Labuschagne floats it up on off, it turns slightly as Sarfraz gets low to sweep. Gets caught on the front pad and the appeal goes up, soon followed by the finger. The Pakistan captain signals the 'T' and it's taken upstairs. Replays show the ball to be clipping the off stump. Barely. Unfortunate for the skipper. He misses out on another ton. The lead is of 537.
Review taken. Sarfraz Ahmed is caught leg before and given out. He quickly takes the DRS. Might be missing the off stump. Over to the TV umpire...
Tossed up outside off, Sarfraz looks to go big inside out but fails to connect.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and turn it with the spin on the leg side.
Waits for the ball to come to him before dabbing it wide of point for a run.
Works it off his pads but gets no run for it.
Stays back to this shorter ball and keeps it out off the back foot.
Loopy and full in line of the stumps, swept away but not with great timing in front of square leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A stumping appeal is referred upstairs by the umpire. Mohammad Abbas is the man in question.

Safe! Abbas comes forward to play for the turn when there isn't any. It goes past the outside edge and Paine whips the bails off after collecting the ball. It's taken upstairs and replays show Abbas is fine.
Full and outside off, Sarfraz drags the sweep through the square leg area for one.
Some slight turn away from around off, Ahmed gets an edge through the vacant slip cordon for a couple of runs.
Flat, short and well outside off, cut straight to point.
Goes the other side this time. Flicks it through square leg and takes two.
Short and wide, cut away square on the off side but can't beat the fielders there.
Mohammad Abbas is the new man in.

OUT! Gone. It's umpire's call. The review isn't lost though. Spinning in from around off, Yasir looks to play at it and wears it on the pads. A big appeal goes up and the umpire raises his finger. Shah takes the DRS and replays show the ball to be clipping the leg stump. So, he has to make the long walk back. Pakistan lead by 531 runs.
Yasir Shah takes a review for an lbw decision against him.
Driven through to mid off. Dot ball.
FOUR! Some air on this as it lands on the stumps, swept through square leg by Shah for a boundary.
Coming in, Shah gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flighted and around off, defended off the front foot.
Yasir Shah walks into the middle next.

OUT! What a catch from Labuschagne. Good awareness from the part-time leggie. Lyon lands it around off, it turns every so slightly as Asif gets forward to defend with an angled bat rather than a straight bat. It takes the edge, goes off Paine's right thigh and he has no idea where the ball is now. But Marnus does. He keeps his eyes on the ball, dives forward at short leg and takes a good catch.
Drinks break. Also, Nathan Lyon returns to the attack.
Driven through wide mid on this time, well wide of the fielder so a couple of runs result.
Looped up and outside off, the leg break, driven easily through the covers for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square through the off side for a double.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker and spinning away from around off, Asif looks to put bat on ball but misses.
SIX! Smoked! Tossed right up and in the slot, Bilal has no qualms about putting this away. Stands his ground and launches it over long on for a maximum. Pakistan now lead by 522.
Marnus Labuschagne back on.
Short ball, Bilal swivels and then with control pulls it over backward square leg for a single.
Drives this full ball to mid off for no run.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Bilal stays back to this, opens the face and places it behind point to find the fence. Lovely shot.
Short ball, pulled away on the leg side.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, kept out from within the crease.
Full and angling in on the pads, flicked through towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shot. Finds the gap but it's not enough to reach the fence. Still, three runs result. Sarfraz rocks onto the back foot and cuts it to point, where a misfield allows the runs to come.
Short of a good length into the body, Asif goes for the pull and gets a top edge over backward square leg for a single.
Siddle keeps it full, around off, Asif meets it with a defensive bat in response.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Too straight on the pads, flicked away behind square on the leg side for an easy single.
Full in length and Sarfraz blocks it from within his crease.
Similar length, batsman drives it straight to mid on.
Full on middle, Bilal leans forward and drives it through covers.
Bilal drives it to off side.

NOT OUT! Toe crusher from Marsh, Bilal was trying to flick it to leg side but was  rapped on the boot. The Aussies appeal and  the umpire gives it out. Bilal takes a review. Replay shows the ball missing the leg stump and he survives. Lovely delivery from Marsh though.
Review has been taken for an LBW decision given out. The batsman in question is Bilal Asif.
Bilal has defended it getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, Bilal defends it with a straight bat.
Sarfraz defends this good length delivery on middle and leg off the front foot and with a straight bat.
Full and fast on off, Ahmed leans ahead and drives to mid on.
Shorter in length and attacking the stumps, Ahmed keeps it out from his crease.
Similar ball and a similar defense by Sarfraz.
The Pakistan captain has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter of a good length on off, played towards the point region.
A bit fuller this on off, Asif blocks it from his crease.
Bilal Asif is the next batsman in.

OUT! Three reds and that's out. A review is also lost. Azam has to walk back dejected on 99. It is a good length ball around off. It lands and nips back in ever so slightly to beat the inside edge of Babar's bat. He is looking to play at it from the crease, he is not forward nor is he on the back foot. The ball hits him on the knee roll and Australia go up in a huge appeal. The umpire immediately raises his finger as it looks very close but the right-hander still goes for the review, in hope more than anything else. Replays roll in and show three reds and that means bad news for Babar Azam. He walks back after a wonderful innings though.
REVIEW! Big moment in the game. Babar Azam is caught in front of the pads and given out lbw. He's on 99 and hence he's taken the review. This looks close. Could be gone...
Defended off the back foot by Azam.
Very full and attacking the stumps, Azam drives it to mid on. Still on 99.
On a good length but straying on his pads, Ahmed flicks it through square leg for a single. Brings Babar on strike, he is one run short of a ton.
Full length ball on off, Sarfraz strokes it back to MM.
The batsman has defended on the front foot onto the ground.
Short from the bowler, the batsman pulls it hard through square leg for a single.
Short from Siddle,the batsman works it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, Azam cuts it hard through point and the ball races away to the fence.
Full length, Sarfraz tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Short of a length from Siddle, Sarfraz pulls it to short mid-wicket.
Short ball, around off, pulled to short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, forced through the off side for nothing.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Keeps bat and pad close together as he defends this in front of mid-wicket.
On the fuller side of the length, close to off, blocked again.
Full in length and off stump, blocked by bringing a straight bat down.
THE HAMMER COMES DOWN! One of the groundsmen is out, hitting away at the landing area to flatten the area out. Siddle complained of it earlier.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Too straight in line, delicately glanced fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Works it off his pads and on the leg side.
Sharp bumper out of nowhere, Sarfraz somehow manages to duck under it.
Coming in on the hips, worked through square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, Azam punches it to covers. No real intent from the Pakistan batsmen after the break.
A bumper to end the over and the batsman ducks under it.
Around off, kept out.
NO BALL! Marsh has overstepped there. He lands it on a length around middle, Ahmed tucks it to mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery on off, Ahmed defends it off the back foot.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but Sarfraz still goes after it but misses.
Ahmed gets right behind the line of this ball and defends.
The Pakistan skipper has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bit shorter this on off, tapped to point.

Bouncer again but this time Babar goes for the pull. The ball though seems to have got stuck in the pitch due to which Azam was a bit early into his shot. The ball brushes his right shoulder and goes past the right of diving Paine and they get a brace. However replays later show it hit the bottom of the bat and not the shoulder and hence the umpire has given it as runs.
Bouncer time! Bangs this on short, Babar ducks under it to let it go.
Similar ball but this time Azam stands tall and punches this to covers.
Marginally shorter of a good length, punched to mid off.
Attacking the stumps is Siddle, Babar though flicks it to the fielder at square leg.
Drifts on the pads and the batsman flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A bit shorter this time and a bit wide of off, kept out with a straight bat off the back foot.
Good length ball around off, blocked out onto the leg side.
Azam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full again but this time it's angling into his pads, Sarfraz flicks it to deep square leg and jogs across for a run.
Fires this full on off, Sarfraz drives it straight past mid on for a brace.
Mitchell Marsh to share the attack.
Dishes this fuller of a length attacking the stumps, Babar pushes it back from where it came.
A good length ball on off is kept out from within the crease.
Continues with the similar length but this one is a bit outside off. Babar opens his bat face and plays it to point.
Fuller ball around off, Azam does well to defend it off the front foot.
Similar ball but this time Babar stands tall and punches it back to Siddle.
Starts the final session with a short of a good length ball on off, blocked off the back foot.

We are all set to start the third and final session of the day. The umpires and the Australian team make their way out to the center. The Pakistan batting pair of Babar Azam and Sarfraz Ahmed also stride out to the middle. Peter Siddle to start proceedings for the tourists.
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

29 overs, 118 runs and just the 1 wicket - thoroughly Pakistan's session. 487 is the lead, so now you have to wonder what Pakistan's plan is. Will they declare quickly after the break or will towards the end of the day? Sarfraz and Babar have added 115 between them, going on without any trouble. The runs are coming quite fast too. Australia look listless, and you could say are really just waiting for the declaration. Mitchell Starc's injury must be hurting them for sure. Join us on the other side of the break for the final session of the day.
Quicker one darted on the stumps, Sarfraz presses forward and blocks. TEA ON DAY 3!
Floats it up on the stumps, blocked.
Hangs back inside the crease and blocks it out.
Flighted leg break outside off, pushed tamely to the cover fielder.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single. The 350 comes up for Pakistan.
Flat, short and just outside off, Babar gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A solid front foot defensive block from the skipper.
Moves inside the line and works it through square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uses the depth of the crease to get behind the line and then defends.
Plays it by coming forward and keeping it out.
Full and straight from Head, defended quite comfortably.
In line of the stumps, watchfully defended.
Spinning away from outside off, guided straight to short third man.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Nice shape on this as it's looped up on off, blocked from within the crease.
Forces this flat ball through covers and jogs across to the other end.
Goes against the spin and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Driven to long on for an easy single.
Babar Azam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, pushed to covers off the front foot.
This one turns and keeps really low. Coming in sharply and almost takes Babar by surprise. He does well though to get his bat down in time after backing away.
Loopy and full on the stumps, driven down just wide of mid on for a single.
Travis Head called on to bowl.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. Two runs added to the total.
Played away to point for no run.
FOUR! Shot. Too full on the stumps, Azam drives it back past mid on for a boundary.
Eases it through the gap in the covers for a single.
Ahmed plays it off the front foot and into the track ahead.
FOUR! Sarfraz brings up the 100-run stand in style. Short ball, Ahmed goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
He may be a part-timer, but he needs to get a wicket here.
Marnus Labuschagne to bowl now.
FOUR! Short of a good length outside off, Azam stands tall and firmly punches it through the covers. Beats the fielders there and finds the fence.
Knocks it down to long off and crosses over.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Down the ground, through mid off for a run.
Babar now comes forward and finds the gap through the covers for a single.
Fifty for Sarfraz Ahmed! 16th in this format and the second one of this game. Superb stuff from the captain. He drives this through the covers and gets a single for doing so.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the back foot as he flicks it away to square leg.
Full and straight from around the wicket, it's played back to the bowler.
Quick and flat outside off, tapped down on the off side.
Spinning in from outside off, not much flight on this, driven through the gap in the covers. Two more taken.
Uses his feet to get close to the pitch and chips it over mid-wicket. There's a man in the deep so just a single.
Down the ground again, through mid off and another run results. Pakistan lead by 457 runs.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
Picks it off his pads and works it away just wide of short fine leg. One more to the total.
Leans ahead to this tossed up delivery and knocks it to long on for a run.
Turning away from outside off, played to point.
Tossed up outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Jon Holland to roll his arm over again.
A solid defense brought out by the classy right-hander to cope with this tossed up delivery around off.
Babar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted and full on off, Sarfraz plays a sweep shot through square leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A bit slower and shorter around off, Ahmed goes back and punches this towards cover-point.
Defended off the front foot by the Pakistan skipper presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit on the shorter side outside off, Sarfraz waits back in his crease and opens his bat face to guide it through the third man region for a brace.
FOUR! Another fantastic shot by the right-hander, showing his class now. This is short and wide of off, Babar rocks back quickly and cuts it fiercely through point for a second boundary in a row.

FOUR! Glorious!  That is simply gorgeous. Real quality batting as Babar whips this length ball on his pads through mid-wicket for a boundary. He seemed a mere push but the timing was good enough to get the ball across the ropes in a jiffy.
A bit fuller than a good length around off, Azam drives it crisply to mid off.
Babar defends this length ball around off with a straight bat off the bat foot.
Yorker on leg stump, Sarfraz gets his bat down in time to jam it towards square leg for a single.
Fast and full on off, driven down to mid off.
Spinning in on middle and leg, flicked away past short leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Shout for a caught behind but the ball is nowhere close to the bat. Spinning down leg, Azam looks to tickle it fine but misses. Paine appeals, and he can't do anything about it either as no reviews are left.
Straighter one on middle and off, Babar gets behind the line and defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up off break outside off, comes in, the batsman defends.
FOUR! Well placed. Width offered outside off, Sarfraz reaches out to it and runs it past the diving gully fielder across the third man boundary.
Length delivery outside off, punched hard but straight to covers.
Quite full and too straight from Marsh, flicked in front of square leg. Easy run taken.
Punches again, but finds the cover fielder this time.
Length ball rising off the deck, Azam stands tall and offers a firm punch to mid off.
Full and outside off, driven square through cover-point. Agar (sub) chases it down and returns a flat throw. The batsmen take three.
Mitchell Marsh comes back on.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and guards it out.
Top edge but safe! Babar gets low to sweep but it goes off the top edge over short fine leg. Clears the man there and gets two runs.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flat, short and on off, kept out from the back foot.
Comes down the track to this flatter ball and blocks.
Straighter one outside off, run down late down to third man for a single.
Keeps really low again. Length ball angling in on middle and leg, flicked behind square leg. One run collected.

The physio is out to have a look at him. The helmet is off and he's been checked out. Seems okay from the looks of things, but you don't want to take risks with head injuries. A replacement helmet comes out for the skipper.

Ouch! That's nasty. Must have stung. Siddle bangs it in short and it doesn't rise as much. Sarfraz looks to duck but it hits him on the helmet near the ear after brushing off the shoulder. He looks okay, but might need some medical attention.
The batsman defends this from inside his crease.
Here's the change-up. Pounds it in short, Sarfraz crouches low to let it go over his head.
Full in line of the stumps, driven back down the track.
Length ball which keeps a little low, Ahmed blocks it off the bottom half of the bat.
Once again the shape of the ball is being checked and this time the umpire feels it needs to be changed. So a replacement is called for.
Coming in from outside off, Babar plays the correct line as he defends it.
Easily done. Wrists this loopy off break down to long on for a single.
Babar goes against the spin this time. Drives it nicely through the covers and gets three good runs for it.
Plays it with the spin as he flicks it away on the leg side.
Makes use of the feet to give the charge and blocks it out.
Turning in on middle and leg, keeps going down and beats Azam who tries flicking it away.
Nathan Lyon is back to bowl.
Drinks are on the field.
Back of a length outside off, Sarfraz rides the bounce and places the punch to covers.
On the shorter side of things, the batsman doesn't bother himself with it.
The umpires are putting the ball through the 8-shape gauge to check the shape. It goes through smoothly and we can continue.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Moves inside the line, works it to square leg and gets to the other end.
Pushes this defensively down towards mid on from within the crease.
Skidding off the surface as it lands on a length, on off. Azam defends after getting behind the line.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side but misses.
Down the leg side this time, the Pakistan captain ducks to avoid it.
Angling away from a shorter length, Ahmed lets it go.
That's good running between the wickets. Sarfraz cuts this late down towards third man and takes two for it. Brings up the 50-run partnership with that.
Short again, turned just wide of short leg.
Back of a length on middle and leg, it just sits up for Azam who rises and helps the pull through square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle and off, defended back down the track.
Shortish and going down leg, no shot offered.
Brings out the short one on off, ducked and evaded by the batsman.
Length delivery skidding away on off, Ahmed remains resolute as he blocks it out.
Length ball on the stumps, another block.
Full and straight from Siddle, it's driven back down the track with the full face.

Chance of a run out. Ahmed taps it down in front of mid-wicket and takes off. Agar (sub) gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end which he misses. Should have gone to the other end, really.
Sprays it down the leg side, no trouble for the Pakistan skipper to let it be.
Sharp bumper from the left-arm pacer, Sarfraz ducks and evades.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Starc bangs it in short again, into the body this time, Babar rises and defends it down.
Short of a good length on off, blocked.
Shot. Azam leans into this one nicely and creams the drive through the covers. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
Full in length, close to off, defended.
Stays right behind the line and guards it away from danger.
Length delivery skidding on around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Yorker fired in on middle and leg, dug out by the batsman.
Peter Siddle returns to the attack.
7th Test fifty for Babar Azam! Solid knock from him so far. He flicks it through square leg and takes a single to get to the milestone.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side.
Same again. Finds gully.
Tries to do the same again, but finds gully on this occasion.
FOUR! Well played. Didn't have much room, but he still managed to get it away. Short and on off, quite close to him but Babar arches back a touch and runs it down to third man for a boundary.
Full ball swinging back in from around off, blocked from inside the crease.
Well here he is. Seems Mitchell Starc is finally feeling fit enough at least. He's going to have a go with the second new ball first up. Let's see what he can do.
Similar ball, same result.
Pushes this full delivery defensively to the cover area.
Full and loopy on off, Ahmed prods forward and meets it with the full face.
Stays back and keeps it out.
FOUR! Again, a lot of room on offer and this time he puts it away. Sarfraz rocks back and cuts it through point all the way to the fence for a boundary.
Short and wide, Ahmed has room on offer so he cuts it through point and comes back for the second.
Worked away on the leg side and that's the end of the over.
Provides some decent revs on this, Azam is rock solid in defense.
Goes back as this one comes in sharply, Azam clips it down towards fine leg for a double.
Picks it off his pads and works it into the leg side for a run.

SIX! Declaration on the cards soon? Certainly seems so from the intent. A lot of air on this one, Sarfraz jumps out of his crease and launches it over mid-wicket for a maximum. The lead has crossed 400.
FOUR! Shot. Flighted delivery on off, Sarfraz gets low and sweeps this behind square leg to find the fence.
The new ball will be available after 1 over.
Kept out neatly from within the crease.
Pushes it tamely to the covers. Dot ball.
Spinning away from around off, met with a defensive blade in response.
SIX! The 250 is up for Pakistan. Babar Azam on the charge here. He skips out to this tossed up ball around off and smokes it over long off with absolute ease.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Leg break, full in length and close to off, defended solidly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and straight, Babar brings his bat down in time to block.
Touch short, he backs away and punches it against the spin through covers for one.
FOUR! Well-timed and well-placed. Improvisation from Sarfraz. He gets low real quick and brings out the reverse sweep. Places it across the third man fence and gets a boundary.
Skips down the track to this tossed up ball and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. One run taken.
Babar adjusts in the crease to this tossed up ball and defends it in front of short leg.
Comes on the front foot and defends it out.
Muted appeal, denied. Impact outside off. Spinning away from around off, Sarfraz tries to sweep again but is hit on the body.
Another one. A paddle sweep behind square leg and two more runs result.
Gets forward and across before paddling it fine down the leg side. Runs the first one hard and comes back for the second.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and wide, cut square through backward point for a single.
Plants his front foot forward to this one and defends with a straight blade.
Turning in, keeps a bit low as the batsman goes back to flick it on the leg side.
An attempted reverse sweep but it's mistimed. Sarfraz premeditates the shot and gets it off the bottom half on the bounce to the slip fielder.
Nice and solid. Sarfraz presses forward and meets it with the full face.
Full and loopy just outside off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Off break full on off, Sarfraz flicks it to short mid-wicket. Was in the air for a short while, but fell down before it got to the fielder. Has to be careful there.
Gives it a bit more air, Azam comes forward and pushes it gently into covers.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side by Sarfraz to pick up a single.
Wide of off, Ahmed shoulders arms to let that one through.
Sarfraz Ahmed, the Pakistan skipper, comes in to bat.

OUT! The Parathas have worked, says Ramiz Raja on air. After two long hops the youngster comes up with a wicket taking one on the third. Lands this a bit shorter than full length and around off, Asad goes back and cuts hard. The ball bounces more than he expected and this results in a top edge flying to the point fielder at decent pace. AC Agar, the substitute fielder positioned there, takes an easy catch.
Short agani but outside off, Babar goes back and cuts it to point for a run. Not a good start by the leggie.
Starts with a long hop, a very short ball on middle. Shafiq mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket but gets a single.
Marnus Labuschagne to share the attack.
Leans forward and drives this full length ball on off towards mid on.
Gives this a bit more air, Babar blocks it from his crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball around off, Babar comes forward in a solid defense.
Tossed up ball in line with the stumps, Shafiq skips down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. Good foot work from the right-hander.
Slow and shorter ball outside off, turning back in, worked into the square leg region.

We are ready to get the post Lunch session underway as the umpires and the Aussies stride out to the center. The Pakistan pair of Asad Shafiq and Babar Azam will resume with the former taking strike. Nathan Lyon to start procedings for Australia.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

On the other hand, Australia look like they are just going through the motions now, waiting for Pakistan to declare. Their bowlers, especially Nathan Lyon, have tried to get them some quick wickets but luck did not favor the offie much. However, their main concern will be the fitness of Mitchell Starc as he has not bowled a single ball yet. Will he be brought into the attack after the break needs to be seen. Join us in a short while.

29 overs , 88 runs and 2 wickets means that the session belongs to the hosts. Pakistan have cruised along to a lead of 369 with 6 wickets still intact. It will be interesting to see when do they declare as a lot of time is still remaining in this match. The hosts have lost both their overnight batsmen. First Haris Sohail was dismissed by Lyon and then a brain fade moment from Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq resulted in a comical run out of the former.
Similar ball on off and Babar leans forward to drive it to the man at mid off. That's LUNCH ON DAY 3.
A bit flatter and full on off, driven to mid off by Babar Azam.
Tossed up on off, Azam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A googly on a length around off, Babar spots it, goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Nicely flighted again around off, comes forward and taps it into the point region for a single.
Very full ball on off, driven hard but straight to mid on.
Babar dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Babar this time stays back, opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. Two runs are added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by Azam presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and drifting down the leg side, worked nicely fine of the fielder there to get a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length just outside off, straightens a bit, Asad taps it to point for a single.
A bit too short and it is punched off the back foot into covers for a single.
Shafiq has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven through the covers to get off strike.
A bit short on off, Azam pulls it to mid-wicket. The timing is not good and the fielder can easily stop it.
Full and just outside off, defended with an angled bat to cover point. They scamper through for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Labuschagne replacing Mitchell Marsh from the pavilion end.
A good length outside off, opens the bat face nicely to steer it towards third man. This time they aren't assuming it's a boundary, all eyes on the ball as the duo comes back for the third run.
Flighted on a length on middle and off, Babar flicks it through square leg and picks up a brace.
Down the track and worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Comes forward, smothers the spin and blocks it out.
Flighted ball on off, prods forward and defends with a dead bat.
Lyon continues with a tossed up ball on off. Babar kneels and sweeps hard straight on the shin of Head at short leg. The ball gets deflected towards fine leg and they cross over for a single.
Tight line. On a length on off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Too straight, on middle and leg, flicked through square leg. One more run collected.
Uses the angle into him and clips it down towards fine leg for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball on off, kept out safely from inside the crease.
Darts it down the leg side, Shafiq tries to flick but misses. Good take by Paine moving to his left.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Asad Shafiq works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball on off, skips down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket again.

Not Out! Prodigious turn on it and that helps the batsman on this occasion. Flighted ball on off, Azam prods forward and looks to defend. The ball spins in sharply and raps him on the front pad. A big appeal from the Aussies but not out given. After a small chat the Kangaroos decide to go upstairs. Replays roll in and show that the ball would have easily missed the leg stump. Australia lose their second review as well. A leg bye has been taken.
Review has been taken against an LBW decision. Looks close.
Fuller ball on off, flicked to mid-wicket.

SIX! Boom! Skips down the track and just deposits this one over the mid-wicket fence. Attacks him on the very first ball of the over. Tossed up ball on off, Azam charges down a couple of steps and heaves it over mid-wicket for a maximum. This partnership has crossed 50 runs now.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! All Class! The classic cover drive. Not many shots may be more beautiful than this one. A still head and some amazing timing as well. A good length ball this marginally outside off, Shafiq comes forward and drives this on the up and through covers for a beautiful boundary. Asad at his best here.
Pulls his length ball and keeps this on off, the batsman goes back and punches it to mid on again.
MM probing away in that off stump channel and dishes this a bit fuller. Shafiq drives it to mid on.
A similar ball on off and an identical defense by Asad.
Good length ball on the off stump line to start the new over, Shafiq blocks it out safely.
Flighted ball on off, driven back to Jon.
Goes on the back foot and punches this shortish delivery to the man at covers.
Sweeps and sweeps hard through backward square leg to get three more.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A very low full toss on his pads, Asad flicks it uppishly past the right of the diving mid-wicket fielder. The batsmen have come back for the second.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.
Nice crisp drive to the right of mid on to take a run and end the over.
Fuller ball on middle and off, turned away to square leg.
Bouncer attempted. Azam spots it early and pulls it from over his head straight down into the ground towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Similar ball to the previous one and Azam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller and straighter on off, Babar punches this back to Siddle.
Marginally shorter than a good length on off, angling into the batsman, Babar tucks it away to mid-wicket.
Asad has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Rapped on the pads, not out. Jon tosses this up and keeps it on middle and leg. Shafiq comes forward looking to defend but misses it as the ball skids through and raps him on the front pad. A stifled appeal ensues but not much after that.
Similar ball to the first one and an identical shot played. However, this time he finds the gap and gets a run for it.
Flighted again on off, driven softly to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, strides ahead in a solid defense.
Goes back to this shortish ball on off and tries to punch it through cover-point. Mistimes it to the man at point.
Prods forward to this fuller ball on off and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Shorter in length, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Drags his length back a bit and lands this on a good length attacking the stumps. Shafiq taps this to mid-wicket.
Strays on his pads but Asad has missed out on a scoring opportunity. He flicks a full ball on his pads straight to the fielder at square leg.
Much fuller on off, Shafiq drives this crisply to mid off.
MM lands this on a good length around off, Asad leans and defends it under his eyes. Good ball and a good solid defense.
Babar has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tucked in front of square leg for one.
Works it away against the turn to square leg for one.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They manage to come back for the second.
Taps this away in front of cover and takes a quick single.
Spinning away from outside off, left alone.
Jon Holland is back from the other end.
Babar Azam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Not out! Leg bye. A bit full on middle, and Shafiq shuffles across to flick off his pads. Misses the shot, and the ball hits his front leg. The umpire negates the LBW appeal but Australia are reviewing. Replays roll in and show that it would have missed the leg stump. Australia have lost their review.
Review has been taken for an LBW decision. The batsman in question is Asad Shafiq.

A bit on the shorter side on off, Azam punches it into the cover region and sets off for a quick run. His partner responds well and the batsmen complete the run easily as the fielder at cover has not collected the ball cleanly.
Fuller and straighter attacking the stumps, flicked to square leg.
Misfield and one run conceded. Shafiq stays back to this marginally shorter in length ball on middle, whips it through mid-wicket where the fielder misfields to allow the batsmen to rotate strike.
Starts his spell with a shorter delivery around off, Shafiq taps it into the point region.
Mitchell Marsh comes into attack.
Tossed up ball on off, Azam strides forward and defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Again dances down but this time he keeps it all along the ground as he drives it to the right of mid on to take a single.
Goes back and punches into the cover region to get off strike.

These either stick or don't. Azam skips down the track and looks to whack this full ball over the mid-wicket region. Gets the inner half of the bat and the ball smashes into Labuschagne's body at short leg. He was again anticipating and was moving to his left as the batsman was playing the shot. Runs saved though.
Goes back and blocks this flighted ball around the off stump.

Drinks. Pakistan's lead has now swelled to 320 and with 6 wickets still in hand, the hosts have a firm grip on this match. The Australian bowlers are trying their best to get the wickets but a little bit of luck would be very helpful for the tourists.
Another front foot defensive shot presented by Asad Shafiq.
Comes forward to this one and blocks it out.
Tossed up outside off, Babar leans into it and pushes it through the gap in the covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushes this wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Short and wide, Shafiq goes back and cuts it square through point for a couple.
Jon Holland comes into the attack.

SIX! BANG! A slog sweep, flat hit over mid-wicket. Azam goes down to this flighted ball on off and slog sweeps it with full force. The timing on it is impeccable as the nut is seen flying past the fence at just above head height. Wonderful shot.
Dances down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.

Dropped! Too smart there was the youngster. Shafiq tries to block this flighted ball by stepping out. Gets an inside edge which flies to short leg. Labuschagne at short leg anticipates as the ball is in the air and moves towards his left. As he is moving the ball is now flying past his right side, brushing his fingers. If he would have stayed in his original position, he would have gobbled it. Nathan Lyon is unlucky again.
Tossed up around off, Shafiq prods forward in defense.
Goes back and punches this slower and shorter ball on off through cover-point for a brace.
Just pad and over the top of the short leg fielder. Asad comes forward to defend but misses. The ball raps his front pad and flies over Labuschagne at short leg.
Babar has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Poor fielding this from Australia. They need to save each run now. Full ball on off, Shafiq drives it to wide mid on. Jon Holland positioned there goes down to stop the ball but fumbles and allows the batting pair to pinch a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Asad chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Fuller ball on off, driven to mid on.

FOUR! Smack! Asad Shafiq will feel much, much better after this shot. Banged in short by Siddle looking to surprise the batsman. Shafiq is equal to the task as he swivels and pulls it beautifully through square leg to the boundary, all along the turf.
Shafiq dances down the track but decides to defend the last ball of the over. Single taken.
A bit short this, Asad rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to covers.
Skips down the track does Shafiq and reaches to the pitch of it. Flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, Shafiq comes ahead and defends.
Defended off the front foot by Babar presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes back to this shorter ball outside off and punches it through point to get off the mark. Will be relieved now Azam. Avoids a pair.
Asad has defended it by getting right behind the line of that flighted on on off.
Flicks this fuller ball on middle and leg through mid-wicket. The batsmen come back for the second. Pakistan's lead has swelled to 300.
Shafiq has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Good length ball on off, Shafiq strides forward and looks to defend. The ball deviates a little bit away from him on landing, takes the outer half onto the ground before going to fielder at second slip.
A bit fuller, attacking the stumps. Shafiq plants his front foot ahead and keeps it out.
Marginally shorter of a good length around off, Asad stays back in his crease and blocks.
Tossed up on off, prods forward and defends solidly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted and a bit fuller on off, Babar comes forward and defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Tossed up ball on off, Babar is happy to stay in his crease and defend.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps this hard but straight to the fielder at deep backward square leg. They take a single.
A bit shorter of full length around off, spinning in sharply. Asad goes back and tries to whip it into the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. Going down leg.
Just outside off, on a length, Azam blocks it well. End of an eventful over to say the least from Peter Siddle.
Good length ball around off, blocked from within the crease.
Stays behind this one and keeps it out.
Babar Azam to bat next.

OUT! Absolute comical scenes here! Oh, dear! Oh, boy! Can't believe what we've witnessed here. Don't think I've ever seen a dismissal like this before. Full and outside off, Azhar Ali reaches out to it and gets an edge down towards third man. The ball is rolling towards the fence, but it stops just inside the rope. Starc jogs towards the ball and throws it back in. Here's the thing though, both batsmen are unaware that the ball has stopped inside the rope as they don't pay attention. They meet in the middle and talk about what they'll do on the next ball. Tim Paine sees this, gets to the stumps and as the throw from Starc comes in, he takes the bails off. Ali and Shafiq are found shocked. The former departs as he was still on the danger side of the crease. He can't believe it. Australia needed a dismissal and it's come in the most ridiculous forms. Incredible.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flicks it away into the leg side for a single.
Similar ball on off, Ali works it into the square leg region.
Flighted on middle and off, Shafiq flicks it away with a wristy shot to mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Dropped? Was there an inside edge. On initial look it seemed like there was but replays prove us wrong. No bat there and no harm done. Tossed up ball around off, Shafiq comes forward looking to defend. The ball dips, turns and bounces much higher than the batsman expects it to. It seems like it has taken a thick inside edge onto the pads and lobbed to the left of the short leg fielder. Labuschagne there dives to his left and tries to snatch at the ball and does not hold onto it. Replays later though show it was only the front pad there.
Flighted on off, dances down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Over the wicket to the right-hander, tossed up a bit and wide of off turning back in. Asad does well to go back and steer it through the third man region for a couple.
Goes square again. Dabs this with an open face past point for a single.
Back of a length angling in, tapped down in front of point from within the crease.
Fraction straight in line, nudged down just wide of short mid-wicket.
Moves inside the line and works this towards short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery coming in on off, Shafiq once again presents a straight bat in defense.
Full in length and on off, Shafiq stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
A bit flatter and outside off, allows Asad to go back and tap it towards backward square leg to get off the mark.
Keeps it on off and slow in pace, Asad goes back and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Shafiq dances down the track, gets to the pitch and clips this to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on off, comes forward to block it out.
Asad Shafiq is the new man in.

OUT! How clever and wily is this offie? He was a bit unlucky yesterday evening but has made an impact early today. He flights this on off, Sohail skips down the track looking to go over Nathan. Swings his bat and gets beaten as the ball spins past his outside edge inside Sarfraz's mitts. He whips the bails off as Sohail watches himself get dismissed. A 48-run partnership has been ended.
The right-hander quickly gets off strike, sweeps to square leg and crosses over to the other end.
A bit fuller around off, Azhar does well to stride forward and drive it on the up through covers for three more.

FOUR! Crack! First boundary of the morning, also 150 comes up for the hosts. Short and wide outside off and this time Ali takes full toll of it by cutting it fiercely through backward point for a boundary.
Gets it full, fast and straight. Ali plants his front foot ahead and drives gently to mid off.
Bit too wide, Ali seems content in leaving all these wide ones.
Better from Siddle as he keeps this in line with the stumps on a good length, Ali drives it to mid on.
Dishes out a full length ball on the 6th stump line. Ali covers the line shoulders arms.
Defended off the front foot by the southpaw presenting the full face of the bat. Three maidens in a row.
Fuller in length but a bit wide of off, allows Haris to leave it watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Similar to the first ball, Sohail this time though does not commit to a shot and hangs his bat inside the line of the ball.
Fuller in length but a bit wide of off, Haris leans forward and keeps it out.
Beaten! Beauty from Nathan. A bit quicker and straighter, pitches on middle. Haris looking to block from his crease is beaten because of the prodigious spin away from him.
Second maiden in a row, keeps it wide of off, Ali does not offer a shot.
Wide of off again, Ali is in no rush, leaves it.
A good length ball on off, Ali comes forward a bit and defends.
Fractionally shorter than a good length, it lands and nips back in. Ali trying to punch it through the covers gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
Similar length but a bit wide of off. Azhar shoulders arms.
Good ball by Siddle. Attacking that corridor of uncertainty, Ali is confident in his block from within the crease.
Nathan starts with a maiden. Haris lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Loopy delivery on off, Sohail prods forward in defense.
Again a bit too wide to entice Sohail into a drive.
A bit too wide, Haris does not flirt with it so early in the day.
A bit fuller this on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up ball just outside off, turning further away. Haris shoulders arms.
Nathan Lyon to share the attack.
Too wide of off, Ali lets it be.
Short of a good length on off, defended off the back foot by Ali.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Azhar chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. That kept low and was pretty close to the off stump.
Ali flicks it away with a wristy shot in the square leg region for a brace.
Starts the day with a length ball on off, tapped into the point region.

We are ready to begin play as the umpires and players make their way out to the middle. The Pakistan pair of Azhar Ali and Haris Sohail strides out to the center. Peter Siddle to start the proceedings for the Aussies.

A little recap of Day 2's affairs - Mohammad Abbas was on fire in the Abu Dhabi heat, which got his side a healthy 137-run lead. Then Fakhar Zaman scored another fifty on his debut and Azhar Ali followed suit (remaining unbeaten). Pakistan, who are 281 runs ahead at the moment, will hope to get close to 400. Australia, as difficult as it may be, will attempt to wrap them up under 350. Let's see how it all unfolds.

Pakistan are well ahead in this Test match now, and on the verge of victory, unless something drastic happens. If Australia weren't in a hole already, their troubles will deepen if Mitchell Starc doesn't come out to bowl. He didn't bowl in the final session of the second day and was even off the field for some time. Australia will hope he's fit and ready today. Hello and welcome for Day 3 of this Test in Abu Dhabi.
... Day 3, First Session ...

Australia are going to have a long day tomorrow if the other bowlers, especially Jon Holland, don't step it up. They were bamboozled earlier in the day for 145 by a relentless Mohammad Abbas and now find themselves in a ditch. From how things stand, just seems like a question of how much of a lead does Sarfraz deem enough. Join us at 1000 local (0600 GMT) for all the action from Day 3. See you then!

Satisfying day for the hosts. Ali and Sohail walk off the field and into the dressing room where they are greeted by a smiling Sarfraz Ahmed. The lead has swelled a lot already, with it expected to go up even more. Twin fifties from Fakhar Zaman on debut and an unbeaten fifty from Azhar Ali has put Pakistan in a comfortable position. Nathan Lyon was the only one looking threatening, and he was quite unfortunate not to bag more wickets than he did as he almost drew edges and catches went inches wide on several occasions.
Spinning into the batsman, Azhar Ali flicks it past short leg, towards square leg and takes a single. End of a fine day for Pakistan as the lead is extended to 281. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Turned past short leg again. Can't beat mid-wicket though.
Turning in on off, Ali is forward as he flicks it past short leg towards mid-wicket.
Straighter one on middle and off, defended with the full face of the bat.
Short, flat and quick outside off, goes off the outer half behind square on the off side for a single.

Nathan Lyon seems just unlucky here. Beautiful shape on it. Comes in first and then spins away from around off, beats the outside edge of Sohail's bat. Barely. Paine collects and lets out a frustrated grunt.
Lyon to bowl the final over of the day.

Not out! Azhar Ali survives. He was too far out of his crease and the 3m rule saved him. It was umpire's call, so the on-field call stays. Tossed up on middle and Ali comes down the track to defend. The ball takes the pad first before the bat and there's an appeal that goes up. The umpire denies it but the Aussies review it. Replays show the batsman is safe. The review isn't lost though.
A review is taken by Australia for an lbw decision against Azhar Ali.
Takes a step out of the crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Brings his bat ahead of his pad and defends it from within the crease.
Full and slow, outside off, driven to short extra cover.
Quite slow through the air, outside off, Azhar has nothing to do with it.
Goes deep inside the crease and works it off the hips through backward square leg for a couple.
Comes forward to this tossed up ball and nudges it through mid-wicket to keep strike.
Azhar Ali rocks onto the back foot and defends this ball cautiously.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Landed outside off, Haris makes a watchful leave as the ball goes away from him.
Fuller in length on off stump, blocked.

Is that out? Everyone's appealed. Will Tim Paine take the DRS? No. He doesn't. Lyon comes from around the wicket and floats it up around off, it turns away and beats the outside edge of Sohail's bat. Paine doesn't review as the replays show there's a big gap between bat and ball.
Has to reach again a bit, not quite close to the pitch but he still keeps it away from danger.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Azhar reaches out to this and mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
Too far outside off, turning away, left alone.
Comes half-forward and defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller around off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
29th Test fifty for Azhar Ali! His first one after 8 innings. He would have been craving for that. Will feel quite pleased and relieved now. He works this down towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ali drives it against the spin through the covers for a double.
Worked away on the leg side for nothing.
Goes back when he should be coming ahead, but he still manages to keep it at bay.
Too straight in line, flicked down to fine leg. The fielder from inside the ring chases it down and the batsmen take two.
Coming back in on middle stump, worked away behind square leg for a single.
Stays behind the line of this flatter delivery and blocks.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted delivery on off, Haris blocks without much foot movement.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Maintains his ground inside the crease and works it in front of short leg.
From around the wicket, Holland tosses it up on middle. Sohail presents a front foot defensive shot.
The off break, turning in, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Makes use of the feet to get close to the pitch and then defends.
Looped up and in line of the stumps, Azhar comes on the front foot and defends it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flicked through the big gap in the mid-wicket region for a double.
Azhar moves across his sticks to get inside the line and then works it away on the leg side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Too straight in line, worked away on the leg side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Is well forward to this floated ball and blocks.
Turning away from the batsman, he plants his front foot forward and lets it be.
Spinning away from around off, pushed just wide of extra cover. Ali wanted the single but is sent back by Sohail.
Defended off the front foot by Azhar Ali presenting the full face of the bat. Lead is of 267 now.
A gentle push through extra cover. Earns him a single.
Stays inside the line of this one and works it away on the leg side.

Once again Pakistan have the rub of the green going their way. Sohail comes out of the crease to loft it down the ground but ends up slicing it over a leaping Mitchell Starc at backward point. Three runs collected.
Better. This time Haris gets right behind the line and meets it with the full face.

Edged and short. Australia can't seem to catch a break. Spinning away from around off, it takes the outside edge of Haris Sohail's hanging bat. Falls just short of Finch at first slip who gets low to his left to take it.
Loopy and full, slower through the air outside off, Azhar lets it go as it spins away from him.
Plays this wide of the point fielder and changes ends comfortably.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Works it down on the leg side from within the crease.

Shouts for a leg before, turned down. Always going down leg. Paine thinks about the DRS, but rightly refrains from taking it. Spinning in on leg, going further down as it raps Sohail on the pads who misses the flick shot.
Flighted and pitched outside off, Ali drives it through the cover region and takes one.
Off break landing outside off, full in length, Sohail has nothing to do with that.
Length delivery spinning away, dabbed square to the point fielder.
Haris has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays inside the crease and blocks it out from within the crease.
Plays this with the spin and dabs it square to point.
Drifting in on middle stump, Haris uses the depth of the crease to go back and meet the ball with a defensive bat.
Outside off, left alone to end the over.
Sliding across, goes back and cuts it late down towards third man for one.
Full and straight, played back to the bowler.
Comes ahead to this fuller length delivery and pushes it through the covers. One more taken.
Fraction straight in line, flicked to mid-wicket for a run.
Azhar Ali opens the face of the bat, plays with the spin and guides it to point for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning away a touch on off, goes back and places it towards point.
A mishit which lands safely. Sohail charges out and looks to clear the infield. Gets a top edge but still clears the cover fielder. Two runs taken. Lyon won't mind this at all.
Darts it quick once more, forced to the packed cover region.
On the front foot once more as he blocks with a straight bat.
Quicker through the air on off, Sohail presses forward and dead-bats it.
The arm ball, sliding in on leg, worked away behind square leg.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through. Was outside off and turning away.
Skips out of his crease to get close to the pitch and defends.
Goes with the turn but it's from the outer half. Played to point for nothing.
Seeing the ball landing outside off, Ali covers the line and lets it be.
Drifting in from around off, defended with the full face of the bat.
Pushed with hard hands down on the off side from the back foot.
Sohail gives the charge and meets the ball at its pitch. Blocked.
Quick, flat and outside off, dabbed square to point. No run taken.
Goes with the spin and turns it past short leg. Single taken.
Short and rising off the deck, Azhar backs away and awkwardly keeps it down in front of first slip.
Darted full and on leg, Sohail works it wide of the man at mid-wicket for one.
Comes forward to this tossed up ball and drives it to covers.
Edged and safe! Looped up outside off, turning away, Azhar Ali reaches out to it and gets an edge as a result. It flies past the diving slip fielder and a couple of runs are taken.
Stays behind the line and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floats it up there, just outside off, blocked with the full face.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Ali works it in front of square leg.
Sohail comes right forward to this flighted ball on off and defends it with a dead bat.
Sohail has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on off,  defended off the front foot by Sohail with a straight bat.
Full and flat on off, Haris was beaten as he missed the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the southpaw presenting the full face of the bat.

Shot! Dances down the track, reaches to the pitch of the ball and swings it straight through the line of the ball over the bowlers head. The timing though is not that good and the batsmen are reduced to just a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sohail this time camps back to punch it through point and takes a single.
A bit short of full length, Ali goes back and taps it into the point region to get off strike.
Tries to go from the sweep but totally mistimes it to short mid-wicket.
Slower and fuller again, the southpaw gently drives it through mid off to get off strike.
Flighted ball around off, driven to long off to get a single.
Jon Holland is brought into the attack.

DROPPED! Sohail gets away from a king pair. Lyon flights this on middle and off. It pitches and turns away from Sohail who gets a nick to it. Paine fails to collect it as does the slip fielder. They complete 2 runs as the ball rolls towards third man. The problems continue for the visitors.
Harris Sohail is the new man in.

Drinks. Just before the break the hosts lost their second wicket but they are still way in front in this game with a lead of 243 and with 8 wickets in hand. Australia will be desperate for some quick wickets before end of day's play.

OUT! Amazing caught and bowled! Lyon flights it nicely around off. Zaman skips down the track and blasts it straight back. Lyon, almost in an attempt to avoid the ball, turns his body but keeps his eyes on the ball. His reflexes help him to catch that one off his own bowling and the offie is up and running in this innings.
The southpaw dances down the track and does well to block the ball as he has not reached to the pitch of it.
Flighted ball on off, flicked to mid-wicket and a single results.
Too full and too straight to go for the cut shot but the southpaw does exactly that. He gets enough bat on it to exchange strike.
Lovely ball! Flighted ball on middle and off angled in from around the wicket. It dips, lands and spins to zip past Zaman's outside edge.
Slower and shorter this around off, Ali rocks back and punches through point for a brace.
Zaman flicks it away with a wristy shot through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Over compensates this time and bowls a full toss. Zaman takes full toll of it and caresses it through covers for a beautiful boundary. FZ moves on to 64 with that shot.
Shorter in length and it stays very low. Zaman goes back looking to punch it but mistimes it completely
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Zaman sweeps it to the fielder at backward square leg.
A very full ball on off, drilled back to the bowler.
AA has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full on off and it is flighted nicely, defended off the front foot by Azhar.
Tossed up ball on off from around the wicket. Ali lunges forward to defend.
Just too easy this for the hosts. Zaman punches this short ball into the cover-point region and gets a run for it.
Flighted ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Goes back again and luckily manages to get some bat on it to work it into the square leg region. If he would have missed it he would have been a candidate for LBW.
Zaman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball to covers.
Zaman waits for this shortish ball around off to arrive near him, opens his bat face to steer it into the third man region for a brace.
Ali drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
A bit too short but Ali cuts this straight to the man at point. Missed out on a scoring opportunity there.
Super delivery for no result. Tossed up ball on off, Ali prods forward in defense but is beaten by the flight and spin away from him.
Too full, a full toss in fact. Driven easily down to long on for a single.
Similar ball this and Ali again goes back to flick it to square leg.
Goes back to this flatter one on off, turns it into the leg side with a wristy shot.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed into the gap at covers off the front foot to get a run.
Slower and a bit shorter turning into Ali, he gets inside the line of the ball and works it into the square leg region to get off strike.
Comes forward to this flighted ball on off, turns it away into the square leg region.
Defended off the back foot by Ali.
FZ has been hit on the pads as he tries to sweep that one. The Aussies ask the question but the umpire isn't interested in the appeal.
Tapped off the back foot by Labuschagne into the gap at covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Ali this time says if you can drive I can drive better. The right-hander gets a brace for his shot through cover-point.
Very full ball on off, driven nicely through covers for a single.
Similar ball and Zaman plays an identical defense.
A bit flat and on the middle and leg stump line, Zaman goes back and blocks it out.
A flighted and full ball is driven handsomely through covers for a brace by Azhar.

Edged and it flies past first slip. Zaman comes forward looking to keep this one out off the front foot. The ball lands and spins away taking the outside edge of Zaman's bat. The ball though goes past the first slip fielder and the batsmen get three.
Gives this one a bit more air, Zaman waits for it to arrive and then taps it down to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit too slow and short, Ali punches this towards point to get off strike.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Ali has played this through mid-wicket. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Missed stumping chance! The Aussies cannot afford such lapses. Zaman dances down the track looking to whack this one over the wide long on fence. The southpaw gets beaten in the flight as he does not reach the pitch of it but still goes through with his shot. Gets beaten but Paine behind fails to catch the ball cleanly allowing FZ to return back in his crease.
Flighted and very full outside off, driven through cover-point for another run.
Very short outside off, Zaman manages to cut it to deep point for just a single.
A bit too short allowing Azhar to punch it through cover-point and exchange strike.
Quicker through the air around off, Ali keeps it out off the back foot.
Marnus Labuschagne comes in to roll his arm over.
Goes for the sweep but it goes straight to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lovely bowling. This one again lands on middle and off and spins away from Zaman. The left-hander is looking to block it but gets beaten as he plays inside the line.
The southpaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit too straight on the stumps, flicked into the square leg region.
Beaten! Zaman prods forward looking to defend but the ball lands and spins sharply to beat his outside edge.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Pakistan are on the go here. Ali goes back to this shortish ball around off and square cuts it magnificently through point for a boundary.
Lands it fuller around off, Ali drives it to mid off off the front foot.

Fifty for Fakhar Zaman! He becomes the first Pakistan opener who has made half centuries in both the innings of his debut match. The 4th Pakistan player overall and the 17th player in cricket to achieve this feat. Full ball on off, Zaman drives it to mid off and gets a run for it.
FOUR! Cuts and cuts well! Seeing the length a bit short he goes back and across and cuts this one hard through point for a cracking boundary.
Flighted ball on off, driven to covers.
Fired in straighter, attacking the stumps. Ali has flicked it into mid-wicket.
Flighted ball outside off, Ali taps it to point.
Similar ball and similarly turned away into the square leg region.
Stays back to this tossed up delivery and works it into the leg side with the turn.
Slower and on the shorter side, Ali goes back to punch it into the cover region.
This one is angled down leg, he turns this with the spin to short fine leg.
Another beautiful drive on the up through covers, the fielder there though gets a hand to it to reduce the ball's speed and keep the batsmen down to a couple. The 50-run stand comes up with that.

FOUR! Similar ball but this time Zaman shows us exactly how it should be done. Talk about making corrections quickly! Zaman rises on top of the bounce and drives this handsomely on the up through covers for a boundary.
On a length but wide of off, Zaman goes for the booming drive through covers but gets the inner half towards mid off.
The southpaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wide of off, FZ shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good ball! He lands this marginally short of a good length around off, angling away from the southpaw. Zaman tries to punch it but the bounce is more than his expectation and Fakhar gets beaten.
Ali flicks it away with a wristy shot into the mid-wicket region.
Goes back and punches this shorter ball outside off past point for three runs. Zaman is looking in good touch.
Beaten! Rippa! Bowls this a bit quicker around off, Zaman tries to block it out. The ball lands and spins away from the southpaw beating his outside edge.
Dances down the track, reaches to the pitch of it which allows him to heave it against the spin over mid-wicket for a brace.
Flighted ball this but a bit shorter than full length, Zaman goes back and cuts it to point.
Tossed up ball on middle from around the wicket, Zaman prods forward in defense.
Fuller ball and slightly outside off, Zaman mistimes his drive to mid off and gets a run for it.
A bit on the shorter side on and around off, punched to covers.
FZ lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Similar delivery and this time it is punched to mid off off the back foot.
Smacked but straight to the fielder. This made a good sound on contact. Full length ball around off, Zaman launches into that drive but plays it to the man at mid off.
Peter Siddle to share the attack after the break.
A bit full and straight on the stumps, flicked into the square leg region.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Goes back to this fuller and flighted delivery on off, driven to mid off and a run taken.
Slower and a bit shorter, worked into the square leg region off the back foot to get a single.
Full and straight this, flicked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Short and wide outside off, punched to covers.
We are back for the final session of the day. Fakhar Zaman and Azhar Ali to continue, with Nathan Lyon to take the ball. Let's begin...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Australia might have got a wicket, but they needed much more than that. Pakistan are well and truly on top as they have scored 51 runs with Fakhar Zaman looking quite fluid once again. The lead has swelled to 188, with plenty more sure to come. The Aussies will have to scalp wickets fast if they want to have any chance of getting something out of this game. The final session will begin in a short time. Don't go anywhere...
Flights this up on middle and leg, wristed away on the leg side. TEA ON DAY 2!
Positions himself right behind the line and blocks it out.
Loops it up around leg, paddled fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Gives the charge to this tossed up ball and works it away.
Stays inside the crease and keeps it out to safety.
Azhar Ali has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Leans ahead to this off spinner and wrists it down to mid on.
Spinning in from outside off, Ali is well forward in defense.
Short again, flat outside off, punched through to sweeper cover for a run.
Rocks onto the back foot to this flatter ball and cuts it down to gully.
Back of a length outside off, punched square to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Beaten! Superb delivery from Siddle. Serves it around off and gets it to move away slightly. It's enough to beat the outside edge. Was so close.
A firm punch offered by Ali as he places it through the left of mid off. A brace results.
Short of a length outside off, it's played down to gully off the outer half.
Short ball banged in from around the wicket, Zaman expects it as he arches back and cuts it over backward point. Three runs are collected.
Peter Siddle is back on to bowl.
Worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Presses forward to this floated ball and dead-bats it.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Lyon drops it short and wide outside off, Zaman cuts it fiercely through point to send it across the boundary line.
FOUR! Shot. Good use of the feet from the left-hander. Charges out seeing the flight and then goes over mid on. No problem for Zaman to find the boundary.
Beaten! Continues from around the wicket and tosses it up on off. It drifts in and then turns away sharply. Beats Zaman who comes forward to block it.
Full and loopy on middle and off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Too far outside off, no reason for the batsman to bother himself with that one.
Back of a length on middle and off, Ali gets behind the line, rises on his toes and blocks it in front of him.
Short of a good length outside off, kept out off the back foot in front of covers.
FOUR! Overpitched and that's through for a boundary. Outside off, Azhar just gets bat on it, directs it through cover-point and lets the timing do the rest. No stopping that one.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Seaming across from a good length, the batsman covers the line and lets it go.
Quicker one darted in on the stumps, kept out tightly by the left-hander.
Comes out of the crease and turns it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Swept and swept away well. It's tossed up on middle and leg, Ali gets low and brings out the broom, to place it through backward square leg and find the fence.
Straighter one outside off, left alone.
Sharp turn. Spins in a long way from outside off, Azhar Ali goes back to defend but is caught high on the thigh pad, outside the line of off stump.
Turn straightaway from Lyon. A good sign for him. Spinning in on middle and off, Azhar is forward as he turns this towards short fine leg.
Nathan Lyon is into the attack now. He got 4 wickets in 6 balls in the first innings. Australia will hope he can produce something similar right now as well.
FOUR! Too straight from Starc. Bowls a back of a length ball on middle and leg, Zaman gets inside the line and pulls it through backward square leg for another boundary.

No ball and FOUR! A loose full toss from Mitchell Starc, outside off, easy pickings for Fakhar Zaman as he drives it through the big gap in the covers for a boundary. Starc overstepped, so he'll have to reload.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Zaman goes at it with hard hands and drives it to mid on.
On the pads, Ali flicks it down to fine leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Bumper on middle, at 142 clicks, Azhar Ali ducks and evades.
Azhar Ali is next in at no.3.

OUT! GONE! That catching cover fielder has come into play. This will bring a smile to the Australians' faces. Starc pitches it fuller outside off, Hafeez just checks his drive for some reason and as a result, chips it straight to Travis Head at short extra cover. Soft dismissal, much like the first innings, for Hafeez. Not the ideal day for the birthday boy.
Goes full, searching for the yorker, swings it back in and Zaman flicks it through mid-wicket. It will get him three good runs.
Too straight in line, easy enough for The Professor to clip it behind square leg and collect a brace.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, arms are shouldered to it.
A short mid-wicket in place for Hafeez.
On middle and leg, coming into the batsman, Zaman manages to flick it behind square on the leg side off the inner half. Single taken.
Sharp bumper from Siddle, on middle and off. Zaman initially looks to play at it but then decides to arch back and evade it.
Angling back in on middle stump, on a full length, flicked hard through the mid-wicket area for a double.
Full outside off, driven to mid off with a high backlift.
Angling away, outside off, no shot offered by the right-hander.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Hafeez rises and taps it down square on the off side from the outer half. Rushes and manages to come back for the second.
Seaming in, on middle and leg, worked down in front of short mid-wicket.
Beaten! Landing on off and going away with the angle, Hafeez is half-forward as he looks to defend inside the line. Beaten past the outside edge.
Full and wide outside off, Hafeez has plenty of room as he drives it square through point. It doesn't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him a couple.
Full delivery swinging back in around off, Hafeez plants his front foot forward to drive, but gets it off the inner half on the leg side.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Rising sharply from a length on middle and leg, blocked from the crease to the left of the bowler.
Fraction straight in line as it's angling in, Zaman works it away in front of square leg and comes back for the second.
Just outside off, on a good length, blocked away on the off side.
Shaping away from around off, on a good length, dabbed to point with an open face.
Full in length just outside off, driven to mid off for no run.
Peter Siddle to bowl from the other end.
Stifled shout, turned down. Height being the issue. Length delivery rising off the surface, Hafeez can't put bat on ball and is caught high on the thigh pad.
Hafeez taps this down in front of covers and takes off as he wants the run. Is sent back in time as the fielder is quick to the ball. Good call.
Yorker on the stumps, dug out well by Hafeez to keep it at bay.
Well outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, flicked down towards fine leg by Zaman to get going with a single.
Full and fired just outside off, pushed away off the front foot in front of covers.
